reason: A browser UI plugin that adds a compact turn navigator to long DSH Web conversations, with hover previews, click navigation, keyboard support, and anchored loading of older history.

summaries.zh: 为较长的 DSH Web 对话提供紧凑的用户轮次导航、悬停文本预览和点击跳转功能。
summaries.en: Adds a compact turn navigator to long DSH Web conversations with hover text previews and click-to-jump navigation.

capabilities: Renders a compact navigator for user turns in existing conversations
Jumps to selected turns on click
Requests anchored loading of older conversation history through the host
